run_experiment_training: run a jaxline Experiment to train a graph neural network on sorting networks or OGB Code2 dataset
evaluate_model_predictions: evaluate a trained graph property prediction model on validation and test splits with performance metrics
restore_checkpoint_state: restore a pretrained model state from a dill checkpoint file into the in-memory checkpointer
save_checkpoint_state: save the current experiment state including params, opt_state, and network_state to a dill checkpoint file
compute_performance_metrics: compute accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 metrics for sorting network or OGB graph property predictions
